rationale.campaign_length: Y99直接任务87项，另有共享Xiaken任务与前身阶段。
rationale.colonization: 任务重点是既有领土整合，不是殖民。
rationale.complexity: 前身选择、改革、形成条件、气功、学校、继承和长树互相锁定。
rationale.dark_story: 整体正道叙事，但恶魔清剿和战争并非无代价。
rationale.difficulty: 形成条件和长树管理复杂，社区经验不能替代实机测评。
rationale.diplomacy: 附庸、宗主、使者、和平形成和多入口统一都很关键。
rationale.early_pressure: 命令秩序及多方邻国使形成前破局压力高。
rationale.magic_artifice_intensity: 气功与宗教力量贯穿任务，但不是传统法师国家。
rationale.narrative_density: 前身分裂、武学、正道、命令秩序和解放构成长线叙事。
rationale.tall_play: 前身和Y99都经营仙界核心、寺院、学校与道路，但终局偏宽。
rationale.trade_economy: 市场、道路、朝圣和香料/区域发展任务提供经济建设，但不是纯贸易国。
rationale.warfare: 形成战争、正道解放、击退怪物和东洲任务都要求持续战争。

identity.appearance: 侠客国家连续链的统一结果；不同Xiaken/Wulin前身均可能通过战争或和平决议汇入Y99。
identity.formation_scope: 多个Xiaken/Wulin入口→Y99；形成后替换非通用任务并加入one_xia改革，Y99本身无进一步国家形成链。

survey_region.note: 2026-10-09用户确认：一侠与Xiaken Nations分区相同，统一归Haless。仅共享地区分类，不声称One Xia/Y99与评分表前身体系是同一调查对象，也不转移排名或评分。

national_ideas.scope_note: 国家传统、七项国家理念与野心；不含可选理念组、种族/政府加成。多套候选与条件分别列示，不视为同时叠加；形成时是否接受新理念由实际事件/决议与玩家选择决定。

description.text: 仙界，五行八作之人习武、修身、成圣于此。而今诸法一统，众宗合一，一侠已有天下最为勇猛之师！
description.text_en: The Xianjie is a diverse realm of martial arts, heroes, and devotion to self perfection. With many of the different temples and techniques combined into a new united nation, the One Xia now commands the fiercest group of fighters Haless has ever seen.

description.text: 侠岛乃天下之中，升道与诸侠皆发轫于此。仙界之人皆伏其为至圣之地，以之香火不绝而其人愿尽东道主之劳。
description.text_en: At the center of Halann lies Xiadao, the birthplace of the Accretive Path and the start of the Xia alliance. The highly devoted people of the Xianjie regard it as the most sacred place in the realm, frequently visiting to pay respects and take great care in maintaining the city's image.

description.text:
一侠之陲，虎狼环伺。北有邪法之徒，西驻命令秩序难撼之师，而边方奸雄割据于东。

亡我侠道，灭我升道之心，众敌之所志。侠道的宗师必以真信慑敌，而解民倒悬于邪祟之手。
description.text_en:
The One Xia has many enemies that surround its borders, with evil practitioners of dark magic to the north, the terrifying disciplined Command to the west, and the tyrannical warlord of Bianfang to the east.

All of these foes have a united goal of destroying the One Xia, and crushing the heart of the Accretive Path. The masters of the Xia must enlighten these enemies on the power of the true faith, and liberate these regions from evil once and for all.

effects.display: 对其他宗教的战争分数花费：-15%
effects.label_zh: 对其他宗教的战争分数花费

description.text:
一侠虽名为侠道归一，实则宗派之内，多有仇隙未除。正道枢密会掌权于众、释怨于各宗，集众宗各长之智，理侠道内外之事。

这个委员会有效地解决了困扰国家的小问题，并扩大了政府的权力，使其成为一个有能力的中央集权国家。
description.text_en:
Although the One Xia was united in name, many of the temples still had issues with rival monks who they fought against in the past. To resolve these disputes, while also centralizing the government, the Righteous Conclave was established, a parliament filled with all of the masters in the Xianjie created to settle affairs both internally and externally.

This council efficiently solved the petty issues that plagued the nation and expanded the government's power to become a competent centralized state.

description.text: 一侠的顶级大师必须是同辈中最强壮的，为了这个角色，大师经常会面临一对一的挑战。虽然对外国人来说，这似乎是一种不稳定的领导方式，但这一传统使正义大师的头衔仅限于最强大的战士。
description.text_en: The top master of the One Xia must be the strongest of his peers, and a master is frequently challenged to one-on-one duels for the role. While this seems like an unstable way of leadership to foreigners, this tradition keeps the title of Righteous Master limited to only the most powerful fighters.

description.text: 这是仙界和它众多的寺庙的一个常见的绰号，因为它生产在整个东洲交易的大部分的熏香（或者用烟州话来说，「丹药」）和香制品（「丹药制品」）。商人们仅凭香气（丹香）就知道他们来到了仙界！他们从一侠购买的熏香（「丹药」）往往用于仪式，香水、香精，甚至治疗之用。
description.text_en: A common nickname for the Xianjie and its numerous temples, as it produces most of the incense and scented materials that are traded throughout all of Haless. Merchants coming to the Xianjie are able to know that they arrived just based on smell alone, and the incense they buy from the One Xia is used for ceremonies, perfume, and even therapeutic purposes.

description.text:
升道和化道是普通人实践的宗教，许多当地村庄的传说都被融入到信仰中。因为此二道是平民订立，并且忠实执行的，所以，一侠是一个抛弃了邻国常见理念的国家。

烟州、罗阇阶级之礼，封建之制，非我一侠所尊，命者，暴王所作，穷人所术，非仁者之言也。为才是举，惟德是辅，我一侠所志也。
description.text_en:
The Accretive and Transmutative Paths are religions practiced by the common people, with many of the local village legends being incorporated into the faith. The Two Path were made by the commonfolk and practiced faithfully by them, and as a result the One Xia was a state which abandoned the ideas of their neighbors.

Eliminating any concept of the class societies found in the Raj and Yanshen, the people of the One Xia believed that no one is born into a social class, and the worth of a person would be determined by their contributions to their society.

effects.display: 正统信仰省份提供的人力：+20%
effects.label_zh: 正统信仰省份提供的人力

description.text: 流水派的弟子被教导在战斗中要迅速，以不可阻挡的力量进行攻击，并始终对变化或创新持开放态度。大多数流水派大师都有魔法天赋，而且该派声称与游侠河的古老水灵有着深厚的联系。
description.text_en: The disciples of the School of Flowing Water are taught to be swift in combat, to strike with unstoppable force, and to always be open to change or innovation. Most Flowing Water masters are magically gifted, and the School claims a deep connection with the ancient water spirits of the Youxiahe.

description.text: 在游侠河的尽头，一座古老的堡垒寺院坐落在一个河岛之上。这个城堡被称为江流寺，是流水派的所在地，是仙界的政治和经济中心，也是侠岛的首都。据称，江流寺几乎是不可攻破的，只沦陷过两次——一次是被诃利秣攻破，另一次是被贾赫攻破。
description.text_en: At the end of the Youxiahe, an ancient fortress monastery lies atop a river isle. Known as the Jiangliubao, this citadel is the home of the School of Flowing Water, the political and economic center of Xianjie, and the capital of the Xia. The Jiangliubao is purported to be practically un-siegeable, having fallen only twice - once to Harimar, and then to Jaher.

description.text: 仙界的森林位于罗祆和烟州两地之间，而江流寺则位于仙界的中心。因此，江流寺的僧侣和他们的河堡掌握了两地之间大部分交通。
description.text_en: The forests of Xianjie lie between the two lands of Rahen and Yanshen, and Jiangliusi lies at the center of Xianjie. Consequently, the monks of Jiangliusi and their river fortress play host to much of the traffic flowing between the two lands.

description.text: 许多世纪以前，升道和化道的追随者们在东洲广袤的土地上活动，他们不向任何统治者低头，以每个人认为合适的方式练习他们的武术。3世纪初，在诃利秣死后的混乱中，各个门派在一个名义上的领主：江流寺的领导下联合起来。
description.text_en: Many centuries ago, the followers of the Accretive and Transmutative Paths ranged far and wide across Haless, bowing to no sovereign and practicing their martial arts in the ways that each individual saw fit. In the early 200s, during the chaos in the wake of Harimar's death, the various schools united under the leadership of one nominal sovereign: Jiangliusi.

description.text: 270年，第一任武林盟主开剑邀请所有正道掌门在江流堡举行峰会。随着诃利秣帝国灰飞烟灭，内战的混乱也渐渐平息，不同的侠客门派开始蠢蠢欲动和不守规矩，因此，开剑大师试图加强侠客门派之间的联系，以保持侠道的团结。经过许多天的激烈辩论——嘴上和手上——大家一致决定，这项活动将成为一个传统。每隔十年，各位正道掌门都会在江流寺聚会，讨论践行侠道的方向。
description.text_en: In 270, First Master Kai Jiàn invited all Righteous Masters of the Xia to meet in a summit at the Jiangliubao. As the empire of Harimar dissipated into ashes and the chaos of civil war subsided, the disparate Xiaken were becoming restless and unruly, so Master Jiàn sought to reinforce the bonds between them so as to keep the young Xia united. After many days of heated debate - both rhetorical and martial - it was decided unanimously that the event would become a tradition. Every decade, the Righteous Masters of the various schools and paths of the Xia meet in the Jiangliubao to discuss the direction of the Xia.

description.text:
流水派的大师们对水的亲和力不言而喻，甚至那些没有魔法天赋的弟子也与仙界的河流有着无形的联系。

围绕着江流堡的河岸上有许多水磨和他们设计的其他更神奇的装置，利用水力不仅可以磨碎谷物，还可以灌溉田地或锻造金属。有些甚至被传言是水妖精活动的热点地区。
description.text_en:
The masters of the School of Flowing Water unsurprisingly have a great affinity for water, and even those disciples who are not magically gifted have an intangible connection to the rivers of Xianjie.

The banks surrounding the Jiangliubao are lined with water mills and other, more magical devices of their design, making use of hydropower not only to mill grain but to irrigate fields or forge metal. Some are even rumoured to be hotspots of river nymph activity.

description.text: 这个新时代带来了无数的创新和挑战，每一项都使侠道的压力越来越大。如果江流寺希望保持其在升道上的地位，它必须巩固其对不守规矩的侠客的控制。
description.text_en: This new age has brought about a myriad of innovations and challenges, each one straining the Xia further and further. If Jiangliusi wishes to keep its position at the head of the Accretive Path, it must solidify its control over the unruly Xiaken.

effects.display: 附庸提供的军队数量上限：+100%
effects.label_zh: 附庸提供的军队数量上限

description.text: 与许多自称自古以来就居住在这片土地上的仙界人不同，我们是在相对较晚的时候随着诃利秣的入侵来到这里的。我们最初是被一个较弱的部落联盟赶出伽缚那阇的，后来被诃利秣的军队接纳。在取得许多胜利后，我们被允许定居在仙界的一块空地上，现在被称为舞虹门。于是我们皈依升道，并融入当地文化。我们的人民仍然有理由自豪，因为我们打造了自己的家园，我们作为坚强战士的遗产继续激励着现在的士兵。
description.text_en: Unlike many of the Xianjie, who can claim to have inhabited this land since time immemorial, we have arrived relatively recently with the invasion of Harimar. We were originally driven out of Ghavaanaj by a coalition of weaker tribes, and were accepted into Harimar's army. After achieving many victories, we were allowed to settle in an empty area of Xianjie, now known as Rang Nartak. We then converted to the Accretive Path, and have assimilated into local culture. Our people still take justifiable pride in that we forged our own home, and our legacy as hardened warriors continues to inspire soldiers in the present.

description.text:
虽然我们离开了祖国，但我们仍然保留着大象战术的传统，并融入了独特的军事力量。

我们的战术是利用大象进行毁灭性的攻击，这肯定会粉碎任何敌人。一旦敌人溃不成军，我们就向撤退的士兵队伍投掷闪电标枪。这两种各自强大的技术结合起来，谁也敌不过我们！
description.text_en:
Though we left our original homeland, we still maintain the tradition of elephant warfare, mixed with unique martial powers.

Our tactics rely on using our elephants in a devastating attack, which is sure to pulverize any enemy. Once the enemy is routed, we hurl lighting-powered javelins into the ranks of the retreating soldiers. With the combination of these two individually powerful techniques, none shall be able to stand against us!

description.text:
在每个月的第四天，我们的国家庆祝圣战的节日，胜利之光。每个人都穿白色的衣服，象征着他们的纯洁，并用染料和颜料在道路和寺庙的墙壁上涂上不同的图案。这一切都象征着正义将永远战胜黑暗的信念，这可以追溯到我们国家的起源。

当我们逃离罗祆的土地时，我们以为一切都失去了，但我们找到了一个新家，促使我们的领袖宣布纪念日。这是我们今天以同样的形式庆祝的节日。
description.text_en:
On the fourth day of the month known as Nerament to the men from distant shores, our nation celebrates the holiday of Shèngzhan, the Light of Victory. Everyone wears white to symbolize their purity, and paint roads and temple walls with different designs created by dyes and pigments. This is all done to symbolize the belief that righteousness will always conquer darkness, and dates back to the beginning of our nation.

When we fled the lands of Rahen, we thought all was lost, but we found a new home, prompting our leader to declare a day of remembrance. This is the holiday that we celebrate in the same form today.

description.text:
我们如何知道一个新人是否合格？这是一个困扰了许多国家的问题，但我们已经找到了解决办法。每个舞虹门的僧侣在训练开始时都会获得一件白袍，在单人战斗中击败10个对手后，有可能获得一件新的颜色的僧袍。

任何一个上进者在完成他们的训练之前必须穿过黄、橙、绿、蓝、紫、棕、红、灰袍。在这之后，他们可能会重新加入寺庙作为一个师父训练新的学生。这个系统确保所有有抱负的人都是合格的，并给学生一个明确的目标。
description.text_en:
How are we to know if a recruit is qualified? This is a question that has baffled many nations, but ours has discovered a solution. Each monk of Rang Nartak is granted a white robe at the beginning of training, with the possibility to obtain a new color of robe after defeating 10 opponents in single combat.

Any aspirant must advance through yellow, orange, green, blue, purple, brown, red, and gray before completing their training. After this, they may rejoin the temple as a master to train new students. This system ensures that all aspirants are qualified, and gives students a definitive goal to focus on.

description.text:
在舞虹门中有一句著名的谚语：「当一个新大师被选上，他们整个家族都被选上了。」从实际意义上讲，这意味着当一个新的统治者接管国家时，他们会带着他们的家庭成员一起进入宫廷，在那里他们通常扮演顾问的角色。

尽管这些新招募的人的素质可能不太好，但在不通过传统渠道的情况下，它确实偶尔会把有能力的人带到前线。他们也愿意接受较低的薪酬，这肯定会对我们的财务有帮助。
description.text_en:
A famous saying in Rang Nartak is that 'when a new master is chosen, their entire family is chosen.' What this means in practical terms is that when a new master takes power over the nation, they bring their family members to court with them, where they typically act as advisors.

While these recruits may be of dubious quality, it does occasionally bring competent people to the forefront without having to go through traditional channels. They are also willing to accept lower compensation, which will certainly help our finances.

effects.display: 统治者同文化顾问花费：-15%
effects.label_zh: 统治者同文化顾问花费

description.text: 在我们的南面是广阔的红口城，那里到处都是罪犯和受压迫者。为了传播升道，我们接受一切，因此我们允许一些流浪汉加入军队。这既挽救了这些人的精神生命，又因为这使他们摆脱了贫困而对我们国家非常忠诚，而且也为我们提供了规模空前的人力资源。虽然一些更可恶的罪犯确实不时制造麻烦，但为了这些人的灵魂和他们在战斗中的身体得到救赎，这是值得付出的代价。
description.text_en: To our south lies the sprawling city of Sarisung, filled to the brim with criminals and the downtrodden. We accept all in order to spread the Accretive Path, and as such we permit some of these vagabonds into the military. This both saves the spiritual lives of these men and makes them very loyal to our nation for lifting them out of poverty, giving us an unparalleled pool of manpower for our size. While some of the more odious criminals do cause problems from time to time, this is a worthy price to pay for the salvation of these mens' souls - and their bodies in combat.

description.text:
大象是我们战争计划的支柱，也是我们文化的重要组成部分，拥有它们享有不可思议的声望。因此，王国有许多盛会，家庭可以炫耀他们最好的大象，其中最好的可以被提名。这导致了大象繁育的增加，因为各个家族为了追求荣誉而竭尽全力培育出更好的后代。

虽然这些发展只是略微提高了象群的质量，但却大大增加了象群的数量。这让我们可以派出更多骑大象的战士，而不是普通步兵，这将让我们在未来的战争中占据主导地位。
description.text_en:
Elephants, being the backbone of our war plans and a major component of our culture, are incredibly prestigious to own. Thus, the realm has many pageants where families can show off their finest elephants, and the best amongst them can be nominated. This has led to an increase in breeding, as families breed their best to create finer offspring in a quest for glory.

While these developments have only increased the quality of our herd by a bit, it has increased the quantity of elephants by an vast amount. This lets us field more elephant-mounted warriors, as opposed to regular infantry, which will let us dominate in the wars to come.

description.text:
许多军队依靠纪律和勇气打败敌人，而我们则利用速度。我们的敌人无法对我们的快速打击做出反应，让我们成群结队地杀死他们。这种速度也允许我们打击非传统的地方，迷惑我们的对手和绕过他们的防御。

我们是唯一使用这种策略的国家，因为它需要一种只在我们的寺庙生产特殊的饮料，它能提高我们的战士的耐力和敏捷性，并允许他们达到极致的速度。虽然喝了这款伟大的饮料后，醉酒是一种常见的副作用，但为这种效果付出的代价是值得的。
description.text_en:
While many armies rely on their discipline or courage to defeat their enemies, we utilize speed. Our enemies cannot react to our swift strikes, letting us cut them down in droves. This speed also allows us to strike in unorthodox places, confusing our opponents and bypassing their defenses.

The reason we are the only nation to use this tactic is because it demands a special beverage that is made only in our temples, enhancing our warriors' endurance and agility and allowing for their extreme speed. While inebriation is a common side effect of consuming this great drink, it is worth the price for such effectiveness.

description.text: 一想到我们的修道院，他们就会想到我们的聚会。无论是为了一个伟大的胜利还是为了一个新主人的就职，我们将抓住一切机会举办我们的标志性聚会。这给人们带来了极大的幸福，也在国外赢得了极大的声誉。即使在罗祆的虎王之地，我们的聚会也令人敬畏。
description.text_en: When one thinks of our monasteries, they think of one of our parties. Whether it is for a great victory or for the inauguration of a new master, we will take any opportunity to stage one of our signature parties. This has led to great happiness among the population, as well as great fame abroad. Even in the lands of the tiger-kings of Rahen, our parties are spoken of in awe.

description.text:
当许多其他的侠客门派生产像丝绸或熏香这样的基本商品时，我们生产的是世上最有价值的商品——酒精。每个寺庙都竞相酿造最好的酒，然后卖给其他国家。

我们的烈酒不只用来谋利；最好的总是留给我们奢华的宴会和支持我们独特的战斗风格。当别人生产没有实际价值的商品时，我们生产的商品既有用又带来快乐。
description.text_en:
While many other Xiaken produce such base goods as silk or incense, we produce the most valuable of all earthly goods - alcohol. Each temple competes to produce the finest brew, which is then sold to other states.

Our spirits are not only used for profit; the finest are always saved for our lavish feasts and to support our unique fighting style. While others produce goods that have no practical value, we produce a good that is both useful and joyful.

description.text: 与其他一些寺院不同，我们对武林的忠诚是毋庸置疑的。当其他寺院拒绝进贡并将武林的使者送走时，我们提供额外的进贡并邀请他来改善我们之间的关系。这不仅提高了我们在武林的地位，也提高了我们外交官的专业技能，让我们既能实现和平，又能酝酿可预见的未来。
description.text_en: Unlike certain other monasteries, our loyalty to the Wulin has been unquestionable. While other monasteries refuse tribute and send him away, we offer extra tribute and invite him to improve our mutual relations. This has improved both our standing with the Wulin and the expertise of our diplomats, letting us make both peace and brew into the foreseeable future.

description.text: 曾经，我们的未来似乎已不复存在，我们的庙宇被围攻，我们的军队支离破碎。盖族大军在每一次行动中都占了上风，让我们面对着毁灭的幽灵。在我们最黑暗的时刻，一群流浪的僧侣，被称为一百单八氓，开始了他们的战役。他们骚扰补给线，帮助我们的军队，并在最古老的废墟中寻求技术。流浪者们利用这一切和醉拳的风格，赶走了盖族人，将自己永远珍藏在我们国家和人民的记忆中。
description.text_en: Once, our future seemed lost, our temples besieged and our armies shattered. The hosts of the Kai had prevailed in every action, confronting us with the specter of annihilation. In our darkest hour, a group of wandering monks, known as the 108 Vagabonds, began their campaign. They harassed supply lines, aided our forces, and sought techniques in the most ancient of ruins. Using all of this and the Drunken Fist Style, the Vagabonds drove off the Kai, enshrining themselves forever in the memory of our nation and its people.

description.text:
我们的国家在过去被入侵过很多次，最明显的是被盖族人入侵，但我们总是占上风。其他国家的公民可能会声称战争已经失败，国家已经结束，但我们不会。

我们知道如何保持冷静的头脑，使我们能够在更长的时间内保持对人民的忠诚。喝点小酒，忘却世间烦恼，也无伤大雅。
description.text_en:
Our nation has been invaded many times in the past, most notably by the Kai, but we have always prevailed. Citizens of other nations may claim that the war is lost and that the nation is at an end, but not ours.

We know how to keep a cool head, allowing us to maintain the loyalty of the people for longer than would otherwise be possible. A little drink to forget the troubles of the world does not hurt either.

description.text:
在大多数国家，清醒被认为是最聪明的状态，头脑不会被酒精蒙蔽。在六和行者，我们知道情况并非如此，因此采取了最聪明的行动。

开明的大师们喝最烈的酒是为了超越琐碎的琐事，创造最伟大的创新。我们的一些最具革命性和最有效的策略、手段和法律就是以这种方式创造出来的，今后也一定会有更多。
description.text_en:
In most lands, being sober is considered to be the most intelligent state of being, with the mind not being clouded with liquor. Here in Liukhexingzhe we know otherwise, and have our most intelligent act accordingly.

The enlightened masters imbue the strongest drinks in order to ascend past petty concerns and create the greatest of innovations. Some of our most revolutionary and effective strategies, devices, and laws have been created in this manner, and there are surely many more to come.

description.text: 微风之舞是风舞者的一种格斗风格，是一种特殊的技术，利用木棒操纵风来吹走敌人，而对鹰身女妖大师来说，锋利的爪子也融入了这种武术。微风之舞是一种防御性的战斗方式，它允许使用者在战场上比常规部队战斗更长时间。
description.text_en: The Dancing Breeze is the fighting style of P'ezarang, a special technique that utilizes staves, manipulation of the wind to blow enemies away, and for the harpy masters sharp talons are also integrated into this martial art. The Dancing Breeze is a defensive style of fighting, which then allows its users to fight on for longer than regular troops on the battlefield.

description.text:
风舞者是一个由虔诚的鹰身女妖和人类组成的国家，当风舞者的第三位正义大师大笙使鹰身女妖皈依正义之路时，这个联盟就诞生了。大笙本人就是一位热心的大师，他想把自己的武艺传播给每一个他遇到的人。

他打败的每个人都加入了他的门派，最终大笙打败了一群袭击盖邦村庄的荒野鹰身女妖。他把她们带往仙界，在那里他花了最后的日子向所有他在旅途中获得的追随者灌输化道的精髓。
description.text_en:
P'ezarang is a nation populated by a mix of devout harpies and humans, a union that was created when the third Martial Master of P'ezarang, Dasheng, converted the harpies to the Transmutative Path. Dasheng himself was a zealous master who sought to spread his fighting style to everyone he came across.

Every person he defeated joined his school, and eventually Dasheng defeated a group of wild harpies who were raiding villages in Thidinkai. He introduced them to the Xianjie, where he spent his final days instilling the aspects of the Transmutative Path to all the followers he gained throughout his journey.

description.text: 最初，它是为战死沙场的勇士表演的神圣舞蹈，但很快就变成了平民的节日，他们在午夜时分聚集在当地的寺庙里唱歌、模拟战斗和跳舞。许多参加这些节日的人还戴着类似魔鬼的面具，据说这是用来驱除邪灵的。
description.text_en: Originally a sacred dance performed for the warriors who died in battle, it soon became a celebrated festival for civilians who gather at their local temple at midnight to partake in singing, mock battles, and dances. Many of the participants in these festivals also wear masks resembling demons, which are said to be used to ward off evil spirits.

description.text: 在许多古老的神话故事中，鹰身女妖师傅或大师都是著名的武侠英雄的老师，他们在仙界的南部山脉受训。作为一个智慧和神秘的大师团体的声誉帮助融合了鹰身女妖的传说和仙界文化，提高了他们在邻近寺庙的形象。
description.text_en: Harpy sifuu, or masters, are known in many old mythical tales as teachers to famous martial heroes who trained in the southern mountains of the Xianjie. This reputation as a wise and mystical group of masters helped integrate the harpies to the legends and culture of the Xianjie, bolstering their image in the neighboring temples.

description.text: 虽然武林自称是所有其他侠客门派的首领，但事实是，离侠岛越远，他们的势力就越弱。风舞者是侠岛南部最大的侠客门派，利用自己的大小作为优势，与较小的侠客门派谈判贸易利益，以保护边境寺庙抵御外国侵略者和仙界野心勃勃的大师。
description.text_en: While the Wulin claims to be the head of all the other Xiaken, the truth of the matter is that they hold next to no sway the further a temple is from Xiadao. P'ezarang, being the biggest Xiaken in the south of Xiadao, has used their size as an advantage to negotiate trading benefits from the smaller Xiaken in exchange for offering protection to the border temples against foreign invaders and ambitious masters in the Xianjie.

description.text: 风舞者的首都是一个受欢迎的旅游目的地，因为他们独特的服装风格，被当地人称为燕服，这是一种古老的仙界风格服装，上面穿一件长袍，下面穿一件百褶裙。许多风鹰身女妖在境外旅行时都会穿上燕服，这大大提高了她们在国外的知名度。
description.text_en: The capital of P'ezarang is a popular destination for their unique style of clothing, called yanfu by the locals, which is an ancient Xianjie style consisting of a robe worn as the upper garment while having a pleated skirt as the lower garment. Many P'ezarangi harpies adorn the yanfu style during their travels outside their territory, which has vastly increased their popularity abroad.

description.text: 随着火枪在烟州战争中变得越来越普遍，风舞者的僧侣们成功地利用他们的武术来偏转子弹，甚至削弱火炮的威力。因此，许多仙界鹰身女妖被敌人称为「神风」。
description.text_en: With guns becoming more commonplace in the wars of Yanshen, the monks of P'ezarang found great success using their martial art to deflect bullets and even weaken the impact of artillery. As a result, many Xianjie harpies were nicknamed the 'Divine Wind' by their enemies.

player_overview.avoid_if: 不想面对早期强邻，或只想经营小规模核心领地而不扩张。
player_overview.how_it_plays: 前身阶段破局并统一仙界，形成后培养武学与正道制度，再以外交、附庸和战争推动东洲扩张。
player_overview.overview: 一侠不是单一1444开局国，而是从不同Xiaken/Wulin入口走向Y99的连续战役。你要先在命令秩序压力下统一仙界，再培养气、选择武学、管理继承人与神权，最后用87项任务把正道、朝圣道路和军事解放扩展到东洲。
player_overview.recommended_for: 喜欢连续形成链、武学养成、长任务树和神权大国扩张。
signature_features: 多个前身入口汇成同一个Y99统一结果。
气功、武学学校和继承人塑造长期军事循环。
正道任务把道路、寺院、解放与大陆扩张连成一体。
player_overview.tagline: 统一仙界诸门派，以武学、正道和道路网络把分裂的侠客变成一侠。

reasons: 前身入口多但中后期共享Y99长线任务。
武学、气功、继承人与正道制度改变长期操作。
道路、寺院、外交和战争共同支撑东洲统一。
warnings: 不是1444独立开局国；不同武林前身改变早期体验，形成前须取得统一条件。

positive_indicators: 任务支持多文化国家成员与道路公共建设
任务明写解放村庄、保护正道民众并保障朝圣者安全
values.rationale: 四维按35/25/25/15加权为63（22.4+17.5+18+5.25=63.15，四舍五入）。正面克制证据包括解放受暴政统治的村庄、保护正道民众、修路保障朝圣者安全，以及宗派讨论和调停。负面克制证据是神权改革让各寺院代表终身居住在仙道院、文本直称某些人会称其为人质，并提供“不加入就强行纳入”或“夺地/摧毁”的政策选项。当前脚本未发现活祭、奴役、一般人口资源化或强制剥夺人格的明确节点；不因神权、恶魔清剿、统一、宗教传播或战争范围本身扣分。档位为0-32邪恶、33-67中立、68-100善良。
red_flags: 寺院代表终身居住在仙道院并被文本称作可能的人质
不加入正道时可选择强行纳入
可选择夺取土地或摧毁拒绝者
